findings.failure_path: The revised mechanical-firing instruction still says to build the map before record. The preceding design gate and retained README/reference instructions also require a map, contradicting the acceptance criterion that no operative rule or documentation tells agents to keep one.
findings.smallest_fix: Remove the surviving map-production requirements from operative guidance and reconcile the affected ledger obligations with that retirement.

findings.failure_path: A main .gitlab-ci.yml can include .gitlab/ci/gates.yml containing owner-dispatch.sh ci. The installer refreshes the engine, but its scan never reads that included file, so the stale job starts exiting 2 without the required migration warning.
findings.smallest_fix: Include nested local pipeline files in stale-job discovery and add a regression case for an included nested file.

findings.failure_path: The plan requires both enforced consumers to remove their jobs before this change lands. The supplied profile establishes only an open removal MR for one and an unreachable remote for the other. Their completed migration and green pipelines are therefore an unresolved release prerequisite.
findings.smallest_fix: Complete both consumer migrations and supply their landed references and successful pipeline evidence before landing this retirement.

findings.failure_path: The new rule requires every backstop to read evidence the agent does not write. The retired check's weakness was checking file modification rather than semantics; this does not invalidate backstops that validate agent-authored code, configuration, or artifacts. The universal restriction introduces an unnecessary policy beyond removing this CI layer.
findings.smallest_fix: Drop the universal restriction and describe the specific limitation of the retired presence/change-only map check.

findings.failure_path: The plan attributes subsequent owner loads 'only because of the block', although the supplied measurement establishes transcript ordering without a causal control. Similarly, the reproduced append conflict is generalized into every pair of parallel merge requests conflicting, although the removed engine required modification rather than appending at one position.
findings.smallest_fix: State that loads followed the blocks and scope conflict claims to the observed shared append pattern; propagate that qualification to the reference and register.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the profile places make test and the heavy lane before later specs/register edits, with only check-ccl afterward. The root contract requires the full lane for these changed surfaces and evidence bound to the current candidate; the bounded packet supplies neither final-state full-lane evidence nor an applicable exemption.
findings.smallest_fix: Run the required lanes on the final candidate and provide a validation record identifying the exercised state, commands, results, and remaining gaps.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: CI dispatch removal matches acceptance, but operative guidance still requires building a map.
No new credential, permission, or data-deletion path is visible; removing the merge check is explicitly authorized.
Legacy configuration receives focused regression assertions, but stale jobs in nested pipeline files escape the installer warning.
The added assertions cover core removal behavior; required full-lane evidence does not cover the final candidate.
Legacy ci_artifact compatibility is retained, but the new universal backstop rule exceeds the requested retirement.
Migration ordering is documented; completion of the two enforced-consumer migrations remains unverified.
The removal diagnostic names the repair, but warning discovery covers only a subset of valid pipeline locations.
The measurement supports subsequent loads, not causal attribution; the conflict reproduction does not support every-pair claims.
The affected boundary is an installed cross-repository merge gate; its migration prerequisite lacks completion evidence.
No contract is loosened, but the supplied verification chronology does not satisfy the root contract's final-candidate validation requirement.
